extension.invocation: scientific_python extender.py source.CGNS target.CGNS xmin xmax
current_hardcodes: metadata M09 although M10 caller makes a copy with renamed provenance
extension.guard: Requires xmin<old_xmin AND xmax>old_xmax. Both sides must extend; cannot crop or retain equal bounds.
extension.preserves: Every original polygon and coordinate; adds conforming vertical-chain strips, rebuilds signed NFACE and one-cell-span connectivity.
extension.prediction_basis: 282379 source cells plus187 inlet segments*ceil(extension/.2)+186 outlet segments*ceil(extension/.2). Actual builder/audit count must govern.

extension_controller.reuse: Use as template in a new parameterized controller; never rerun completed one-shot. Existing result gate, source hashes,24GB free-memory/12GB disk precheck, CPU1 import/topology checks must remain.

finalizer.important: Import new region, copy physics/boundary properties, rebind forces to new HF_012_wall, remove old region. Verify independent quality and re-exported topology.

input_setup.warning: Changing only wavelength/height would leave wrong zone lengths, boundary-plane/area expectations and fixed cell count.

native_refinement.warning: Native target extrusion required prior reconstruction; preserve source-plane audit/extrusion/final-import workflow. Regenerated foil edges/prisms must be compared, not assumed identical.
native_refinement.native_builder_parameterization: Clone completed one-shot builder to a newID. build(c) already reads free_surface_m; change design/id/mesh_number/publish paths/allocation exact-ID allowlist, keeping E-backed verified junctions, sourcehash, CPUlock, memory, quality, topology guards. Never rerun completedmain. ImportedM10mesh.sim is not the verified native-regeneration seed.

setup_API.frame: getPointOnLevel().setComponents(0,0,2);getVerticalDirection().setComponents(0,0,1);getAdvancingDirection().setComponents(1,0,0);getCurrent()/getWind().setComponents(18,0,0); preserve existing verified sign convention and audit encounter direction.
setup_API.period: w.getWavePeriod().getValue(); persist actual result per case; reject nonfinite/nonpositive.
setup_API.zones: Region VofWaveZoneOptionEnum.FORCING_DAMPING; only inlet forcingYES/outlet dampingYES. Boundary VofWaveForcingLength/VofWaveDampingLength ConstantScalarProfileMethod.setConstant(lambda). All other flagsNO.
setup_API.bindings: Initial velocity/pressure/phase and inlet velocity/phase bind selected wave; outlet/top pressure/phase bind FlatVofWave Calm. ForcingVofWaveSpecification binds selected wave.
setup_API.BCs: ENVIRONMENTAL outlet with BOUNDARY_NORMAL backflow and SPECIFIED scalar; STATIC top with EXTRAPOLATED backflow direction and SPECIFIED scalar; bed SLIP; foil NO_SLIP; span symmetry.
setup_API.zero_steps: Fresh disposable zero-time mesh.sim copy only; clearSolutionWithoutMeshReset/initializeSolution; never use this initialization path on a computed continuation.
